problem_description: Compute the average temperature in K, pressure in bar, and density in kg/m^3 of the DPPC lipid bilayer system in water. The system contained 128 DPPC lipid molecules and 3840 TIP3P water molecules in a simulation box of dimensions 6.30317 × 6.41851 × 6.68079 nm³. Energy minimization was performed using the steepest descent algorithm for 100000 steps with a step size of 0.002 nm using the Verlet cutoff scheme. Long-range electrostatic interactions were treated using the Particle Mesh Ewald (PME) method with a cutoff of 1.2 nm during minimization and 1.0 nm during equilibration and production, a switching function was applied at 0.9 nm using the vdw-type = switch modifier. Molecular dynamics simulations were performed with a time step of 0.002 ps. During equilibration in the NPT ensemble, the Nose–Hoover thermostat maintained the temperature at 323 K with a coupling constant of 0.5 ps, while pressure was controlled using a barostat at 1.013 bar with a coupling constant of 10 ps and the pressure coupling type should be set as semiisotropic. Bond constraints were applied using LINCS for all bonds. The equilibration was conducted for 1,00,000 steps, and the production run was performed for 10,000 steps with the same parameters as the equilibration run.
